text:
Predicates:
SummerOlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
Last(x) ::: x is the last summer Olympic games.
In(x, y) ::: x is in y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
Premises:
∀x (SummerOlympicGames(x) → SportingEvent(x)) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
∃x (Last(x) ∧ In(x, tokyo)) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
∃x (WonMostMedals(unitedStates, x) ∧ In(x, tokyo)) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Last(x) ∧ In(x, tokyo)) ::: The last summer Olympic games were not in Tokyo.
